text:
# A 61-year-old salaried worker reads the keren hishtalmut page

## 1. My answer: what I would do, and how sure I am

**I would join, and put in only the 2.5% they ask from me.** I'm about 70% sure.

These lines decided it:

- **«המעסיק יכול להפקיד עד 7.5% מהמשכורת הקובעת בלי שזה ייחשב לכם הכנסה»**. My employer can put in up to 7.5% of my salary and I don't pay tax on it. **«החלק שלכם חייב להיות לפחות שליש ממה שהמעסיק מפקיד»**. So I put in 2.5% and they put in 7.5%. That's extra money I don't get any other way.
- **«למי שהגיע לגיל הפרישה... התקופה היא 3 שנים»**. Normally the money is locked for 6 years. At 61 I might only have to wait 3 years. That's what makes it worth it at my age.

Why I'm not more sure than 70%:

- I don't know if the 3 years counts from when I join or from when I reach retirement age.
- The page never tells me what my retirement age is.
- The chart left me cold. After 10 years it shows **17,370 ₪ against 16,955 ₪**, only **415.84 ₪** apart. A bit further down it says the difference could be **«בין 342.02– לבין 2,106 ₪»**. So with a bad fund manager I could come out *behind* a regular investment account. Then I realised that comparison leaves out the employer's money (**«הכסף של המעסיק... מחוץ להשוואה»**). The employer's 7.5% is the real reason to join.

## 2. The parts I actually used

- **The opening summary** under the title, and **"מה זה"**: what it is, the 6 years, the 3 years, 7.5% and 2.5%.
- **"מה מייחד קרן השתלמות"**: the two bars and the small fees/tax table under them.
- **"שווה לדעת"**: the three one-line facts.
- **"כסף נכנס ויוצא"**: the four boxes, especially **«כשעוברות 6 שנים»** and **«עד 4 ימי עסקים»**.
- **"מיסוי"**: the three cards and the orange warning box about taking money out early.
- **"סיכונים ומה לא מוגן"**: the first paragraph.

## 3. Block by block

- **Top menu (מדריך, חוקים וכללים, השוואה למטרה...)**: skipped it.
- **Title and summary**: used it. **«אחרי תקופה שקבע החוק אפשר למשוך בפטור ממס»** told me what kind of thing this is.
- **The little line «123 מקור · 123 מחושב · 123 הזנתו · מנגנון הקישו להסבר»**: this confused me. I didn't know what "123" meant and didn't click.
- **"מה זה"**: used it, and it was the most useful part. I read every word.
- **"למה משתמשים בזה"**: read it. **«המחיר, לעומת קופת גמל להשקעה: עד סוף התקופה, משיכה של כספי המעסיק ושל הרווחים ממוסה»** was clear enough.
- **The buttons "כדאי להכיר גם" and "במה אפשר להשקיע בתוכו" (S&P 500, אג"ח ממשלתית צמודה, מזומן שקלי...)**: skimmed them. I don't know what most of those are.
- **The box "מה הנעילה של קרן ההשתלמות קונה לכם?"**: used it, but it was hard going. The **«שכיר / עצמאי»** switch and **«12,000 ₪»** made sense. **«מיטב השתלמות עוקב מדד S&P500 (13245)»** and **«ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)»** meant nothing to me.
- **The bars and the fees/tax table**: used them (details in section 4).
- **The paragraph about 300 ₪ out of 500 ₪**: I read it twice. **«מההפקדה החודשית שלכם רק 300 ₪ נחשבים הפקדה מוטבת»** and **«על 200 ₪ בחודש מעבר לזה אין פטור»** finally told me: don't put in more than 2.5%.
- **"ההפרש תלוי גם במי שבוחרים"**: this confused me. It's where I found out the difference can go below zero.
- **"שחקו עם המספרים שלכם"**: skipped it. I didn't open it.
- **"שווה לדעת"**: used it. The codes **TXH-09, KH-15, PF-18** next to each line mean nothing to me.
- **"מי מציע ומי מפקח"**: used it. **«המעסיק לא יכול להתנות את ההפקדה בקרן מסוימת»** is good to know: I choose the fund. **«לא נמצא חוק שמחייב כל מעסיק להפקיד»** I noted.
- **The fund company cards (הראל, אלטשולר שחם, מיטב)**: skimmed them.
- **"כסף נכנס ויוצא"**: used it. Clear, big type.
- **"כמה זה עולה" table**: skimmed it. I only caught **«דמי יציאה – אין»** and **«הוצאות ישירות – אין תקרה כוללת»**, which worried me a little.
- **"מיסוי" cards**: used them.
- **The orange warning**: used it, and it frightened me. **«הקרן מנכה במקור 47% מהסכומים החייבים»**. I understand it as "don't take the money out early".
- **«הכלכלן הראשי במשרד האוצר המליץ לצמצם את ההטבה»**: read it. It worries me: could they take the benefit away?
- **"סיכונים ומה לא מוגן"**: used it. **«הנכסים מוחזקים בנאמנות, בנפרד מהרכוש של החברה המנהלת»** reassured me. **«המדינה לא ערבה לשווי הקרן»** I noted.
- **"מונחים" (word list)**: skimmed it. I only looked up **ותק** and **מועד התשלום הראשון**.
- **Bottom of the page**: skipped it.

## 4. Lists, tables and charts

- **The bars:** I looked at the green bar (**קרן השתלמות**) and the yellow bar (**חשבון ניירות ערך**). They are almost the same length, so I went by the numbers next to them. I looked at the line **«אם מושכים אחרי 10 שנים»**. I didn't use the 0–12 year scale above it or **«גררו את הסמן»**, because I didn't know I could drag it.
- **The small table:** I looked at both columns and both rows:
  - Fees: **2,402.23 ₪** in the keren against **466.12 ₪** in the regular account. Five times more in fees! That bothered me.
  - Tax: **2,922.17 ₪** against **5,787.72 ₪**. Here the keren wins.
- **The deposit example**: I looked at **«10,000 ₪ היום ועוד 500 ₪ בכל חודש»**. I ignored **«שינוי הסכומים»**.
- **The "כמה זה עולה" table:** I only read the **סוג** and **תקרה** columns, and only the last two rows.
- **Word list:** I read the right-hand column (the word) and the middle one (the explanation). I ignored the grey tags (**תקנון, טופס, גמל נט, דוח שנתי, אפליקציה**). I don't know what they're for.
- **The green chips «חוקים וכללים · 7»** all over the page: ignored them.

## 5. What I did not understand

- What "123" means in **מקור / מחושב / הזנתו**.
- The codes **TXH-09, KH-15, PF-18**.
- **«הרווח הריאלי»**. I found it in the word list and still don't fully get it.
- **«משכורת קובעת»**: is it my gross salary or not?
- The orange box: **«שמתחת לגיל 60 מתחילות ב-31%»**. I'm over 60. Does that make it cheaper for me? It doesn't say.
- **«47% מנכה במקור»**: do I get some of that back? It says **«מי ששיעור המס שלו נמוך יותר מקבל את ההפרש בדוח שנתי»**. Does that mean I have to file a report myself?
- Why does the keren cost five times more in fees and still come out ahead?

## 6. What I wanted to know and could not find

- **Retirement age.** The whole 3-year rule depends on it. Does the 3 years start when I join, or when I reach that age?
- **What happens if I leave or lose my job before the time is up?** Does the employer's money stay mine?
- **What happens to the money if I die?** Who gets it?
- **Does this affect my pension or my allowances?**
- **What does all this come to on *my* salary in shekels a month?** Not the 12,000 example.
- **The employer's 7.5% in the calculation itself.** It's the main reason to join and it isn't in the comparison.

## 7. If half the page had to go, what goes first

1. The **«מונחים»** word list with its tags.
2. The investment track buttons (**S&P 500, אג"ח...**).
3. The fund company cards.
4. The codes and the **«חוקים וכללים · N»** chips.
5. The 123 legend at the top.
6. The **«כמה זה עולה»** table.

I would keep **"מה זה"**, **"כסף נכנס ויוצא"**, the orange warning and the 300/200 shekel paragraph. Those told me what to do with my money.
